translations.q096: WITH s AS (SELECT TraficSourceID, URL, COUNT(*) AS views FROM hits WHERE URL <> '' GROUP BY TraficSourceID, URL), st AS (SELECT TraficSourceID, SUM(views) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM s GROUP BY TraficSourceID) SELECT s.TraficSourceID, COUNT(*) AS standout_pages, MAX(s.views) AS top_views, MAX(st.n) AS pages_in_source FROM s JOIN st ON s.TraficSourceID = st.TraficSourceID WHERE s.views * st.n > 50 * st.total GROUP BY s.TraficSourceID ORDER BY s.TraficSourceID  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q097: SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS c, SUM(CASE WHEN DontCountHits = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dont_count, SUM(CASE WHEN IsRefresh = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refreshes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN SearchPhrase <> '' THEN SearchPhrase END) AS distinct_phrases FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS sc FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY sc DESC, CounterID LIMIT 10) t) GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY c DESC, CounterID  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q098: WITH days AS (SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS dy, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 0 GROUP BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)) SELECT dy, cnt, users, cnt - COALESCE((SELECT d2.cnt FROM days d2 WHERE d2.dy = days.dy - 1), 0) AS delta_vs_prev_day FROM days ORDER BY dy  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q099: WITH pc AS (SELECT ParamCurrencyID, RefererRegionID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY ParamCurrencyID, RefererRegionID), r AS (SELECT ParamCurrencyID, RefererRegionID, hits_cnt, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ParamCurrencyID ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, RefererRegionID) AS rn FROM pc) SELECT ParamCurrencyID, RefererRegionID, hits_cnt, users, rn FROM r WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY ParamCurrencyID, rn LIMIT 60  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'
translations.q100: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime) AS local_hour, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_hits, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) - (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) FROM hits) AS share_vs_overall FROM hits GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM LocalEventTime) ORDER BY local_hour  SETTINGS join_use_nulls = 1, aggregate_functions_null_for_empty = 1, group_by_use_nulls = 1, union_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', intersect_default_mode = 'DISTINCT', except_default_mode = 'DISTINCT'

translations.q001: WITH reg AS (SELECT RegionID, COUNT(DISTINCT IPNetworkID) AS nets, COUNT(*) AS hits FROM hits GROUP BY RegionID ORDER BY nets DESC, RegionID LIMIT 10), hourly AS (SELECT RegionID, hr, COUNT(*) AS c FROM (SELECT RegionID, CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) AS hr FROM hits WHERE RegionID IN (SELECT RegionID FROM reg)) x GROUP BY RegionID, hr), peak AS (SELECT RegionID, hr, c FROM (SELECT RegionID, hr, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RegionID ORDER BY c DESC, hr) AS rn FROM hourly) y WHERE rn = 1), timing AS (SELECT RegionID, ROUND(AVG(ConnectTiming), 2) AS avg_connect FROM hits WHERE ConnectTiming > 0 AND RegionID IN (SELECT RegionID FROM reg) GROUP BY RegionID) SELECT r.RegionID AS region_id, r.nets AS nets, r.hits AS hits, p.hr AS peak_hour, p.c AS peak_hits, COALESCE(t.avg_connect, 0) AS avg_connect FROM reg r INNER JOIN peak p ON r.RegionID = p.RegionID LEFT JOIN timing t ON r.RegionID = t.RegionID ORDER BY nets DESC, region_id
translations.q002: WITH t AS (SELECT UserID, CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) * 3600 + CAST(EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) * 60 + CAST(EXTRACT(SECOND FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) AS sec FROM hits WHERE EventDate = DATE '2013-07-15'), g AS (SELECT UserID, sec - MAX(sec) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY sec ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS gap, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY sec) AS rn FROM t) SELECT gap_bucket, COUNT(*) AS gaps, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM (SELECT UserID, CASE WHEN gap < 10 THEN 1 WHEN gap < 60 THEN 2 WHEN gap < 600 THEN 3 WHEN gap < 1800 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS gap_bucket FROM g WHERE rn > 1) b GROUP BY gap_bucket ORDER BY gap_bucket
translations.q003: SELECT r.RefererRegionID, r.c FROM (SELECT RefererRegionID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE RefererRegionID <> 0 GROUP BY RefererRegionID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) r WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.RefererRegionID = r.RefererRegionID AND h.SearchPhrase <> '' AND h.EventDate >= '2013-07-25') ORDER BY r.c DESC, r.RefererRegionID LIMIT 30
translations.q004: WITH stats AS (SELECT IsMobile AS device, CounterID AS counter_id, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst FROM hits WHERE ResponseStartTiming > 0 GROUP BY IsMobile, CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50), ranked AS (SELECT device, counter_id, hits_cnt, avg_rst, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY avg_rst DESC, counter_id) AS slow_pos, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY device ORDER BY avg_rst ASC, counter_id) AS fast_pos FROM stats) SELECT kind, device, pos, counter_id, hits_cnt, avg_rst FROM (SELECT 'slowest' AS kind, device, slow_pos AS pos, counter_id, hits_cnt, avg_rst FROM ranked WHERE slow_pos <= 5 UNION ALL SELECT 'fastest' AS kind, device, fast_pos AS pos, counter_id, hits_cnt, avg_rst FROM ranked WHERE fast_pos <= 5) AS u ORDER BY kind, device, pos
translations.q005: SELECT CASE WHEN Referer = '' THEN 'direct' WHEN Referer LIKE '%=%' THEN 'ref_with_params' WHEN Referer LIKE 'https://%' THEN 'secure_ref' ELSE 'plain_ref' END AS ref_kind, IsMobile AS mobile_flag, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hits) AS share_of_all, AVG(IsNotBounce) AS not_bounce_rate FROM hits GROUP BY ref_kind, IsMobile ORDER BY ref_kind, mobile_flag
translations.q006: WITH pebble AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, CounterID LIMIT 20), velvet AS (SELECT CounterID, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER) AS dnum, COUNT(*) AS day_hits, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS day_rst FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM pebble) GROUP BY CounterID, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER)), meadow AS (SELECT CounterID, dnum, day_hits, day_rst, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CounterID ORDER BY day_rst DESC, dnum) AS rn FROM velvet WHERE day_hits >= 100), marble AS (SELECT CounterID, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS overall_rst, COUNT(DISTINCT CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS INTEGER)) AS active_days FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM pebble) GROUP BY CounterID) SELECT p.CounterID AS counter_id, p.hits_cnt AS total_hits, mb.active_days AS days_active, m.dnum AS worst_day, m.day_hits AS worst_day_hits, m.day_rst AS worst_day_rst, mb.overall_rst AS month_rst, m.day_rst - mb.overall_rst AS excess_rst FROM pebble AS p INNER JOIN meadow AS m ON p.CounterID = m.CounterID INNER JOIN marble AS mb ON p.CounterID = mb.CounterID WHERE m.rn = 1 ORDER BY total_hits DESC, counter_id
translations.q007: WITH s AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(DISTINCT SearchPhrase) AS phrases FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY UserID), d AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS actions FROM hits WHERE IsDownload = 1 OR IsLink = 1 GROUP BY UserID) SELECT phrase_bucket, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(actions) AS actions_total, MAX(actions) AS max_actions FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN s.phrases >= 10 THEN 10 ELSE s.phrases END AS phrase_bucket, d.actions FROM s JOIN d ON s.UserID = d.UserID) j GROUP BY phrase_bucket ORDER BY phrase_bucket
translations.q008: WITH early AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-15' GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20), late AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-25' GROUP BY CounterID) SELECT e.CounterID, e.c AS early_hits FROM early e WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM late l WHERE l.CounterID = e.CounterID) ORDER BY e.c DESC, e.CounterID LIMIT 20
translations.q009: WITH shared AS (SELECT UserAgentMinor FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY UserAgentMinor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10 INTERSECT SELECT UserAgentMinor FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 0 GROUP BY UserAgentMinor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10) SELECT h.UserAgentMinor AS ua_minor, SUM(CASE WHEN h.IsMobile = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN h.IsMobile = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS desktop_hits FROM hits h WHERE h.UserAgentMinor IN (SELECT UserAgentMinor FROM shared) GROUP BY h.UserAgentMinor ORDER BY mobile_hits DESC, desktop_hits DESC, ua_minor LIMIT 30
translations.q010: WITH reg AS (SELECT RefererRegionID AS rr, COUNT(*) AS sh FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND RefererRegionID <> 0 GROUP BY RefererRegionID ORDER BY sh DESC, rr LIMIT 10), reg_hour AS (SELECT h.RefererRegionID AS rr, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM h.EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits h WHERE h.SearchPhrase <> '' AND h.RefererRegionID IN (SELECT rr FROM reg) GROUP BY h.RefererRegionID, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM h.EventTime)), peak AS (SELECT rr, hr, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY rr ORDER BY c DESC, hr) AS rn FROM reg_hour) SELECT r.rr, r.sh, p.hr AS peak_hour, p.c AS peak_hits, CAST(p.c AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / r.sh AS peak_share FROM reg r JOIN peak p ON p.rr = r.rr WHERE p.rn = 1 ORDER BY r.sh DESC, r.rr
translations.q011: WITH u AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS hc, COUNT(DISTINCT EventDate) AS days, COUNT(DISTINCT RemoteIP) AS ips, SUM(IsMobile) AS mob, SUM(CASE WHEN SearchPhrase <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS searches FROM hits GROUP BY UserID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5) SELECT segment, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(hc) AS hits_total, ROUND(AVG(days), 2) AS avg_days, MAX(ips) AS max_ips FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN ips >= 5 THEN 'nomad' WHEN days >= 10 THEN 'loyal' WHEN mob * 2 > hc THEN 'mobile' WHEN searches * 2 > hc THEN 'searcher' ELSE 'regular' END AS segment, hc, days, ips FROM u) s GROUP BY segment ORDER BY users DESC, segment
translations.q012: SELECT CounterClass, IsParameter, COUNT(*) AS long_urls, MAX(LENGTH(URL)) AS max_len, COUNT(DISTINCT ClientIP) AS ips FROM hits WHERE URL LIKE '%?%' AND LENGTH(URL) > (SELECT 2 * AVG(LENGTH(URL)) FROM hits WHERE URL <> '') GROUP BY CounterClass, IsParameter ORDER BY long_urls DESC, CounterClass, IsParameter
translations.q013: SELECT a.UserAgent, a.UserAgentMinor, a.c FROM (SELECT UserAgent, UserAgentMinor, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY UserAgent, UserAgentMinor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) a WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.UserAgent = a.UserAgent AND h.UserAgentMinor = a.UserAgentMinor AND h.CookieEnable = 0 AND h.SearchPhrase <> '') ORDER BY a.c DESC, a.UserAgent, a.UserAgentMinor LIMIT 25
translations.q014: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MobilePhoneModel) FROM hits WHERE Sex = 1 AND MobilePhoneModel <> '') AS sex1_models, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT MobilePhoneModel) FROM hits WHERE Sex = 2 AND MobilePhoneModel <> '') AS sex2_models, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT DISTINCT MobilePhoneModel FROM hits WHERE Sex = 1 AND MobilePhoneModel <> '' INTERSECT SELECT DISTINCT MobilePhoneModel FROM hits WHERE Sex = 2 AND MobilePhoneModel <> '') t) AS shared_models ORDER BY sex1_models
translations.q015: WITH top_c AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 50), daily AS (SELECT h.CounterID, h.EventDate, COUNT(*) AS c, SUM(CASE WHEN h.ResponseStartTiming > 500 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS slow FROM hits h WHERE h.CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM top_c) GROUP BY h.CounterID, h.EventDate), monthly AS (SELECT CounterID, SUM(c) AS mc, SUM(slow) AS ms FROM daily GROUP BY CounterID) SELECT m.CounterID, m.mc AS total_hits, m.ms AS slow_hits, SUM(CASE WHEN d.slow * m.mc > m.ms * d.c THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS bad_days, COUNT(*) AS active_days FROM monthly m INNER JOIN daily d ON d.CounterID = m.CounterID GROUP BY m.CounterID, m.mc, m.ms ORDER BY bad_days DESC, m.CounterID LIMIT 50
translations.q016: WITH h1 AS (SELECT RefererRegionID AS rr FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-15' AND RefererRegionID <> 0 GROUP BY RefererRegionID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100), h2 AS (SELECT RefererRegionID AS rr FROM hits WHERE EventDate > '2013-07-15' AND RefererRegionID <> 0 GROUP BY RefererRegionID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100), faded AS (SELECT rr FROM h1 EXCEPT SELECT rr FROM h2) SELECT f.rr, x.c AS first_half_hits FROM faded f JOIN (SELECT RefererRegionID AS rr, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE EventDate <= '2013-07-15' GROUP BY RefererRegionID) x ON x.rr = f.rr ORDER BY x.c DESC, f.rr LIMIT 30
translations.q017: WITH top_regions AS (SELECT RegionID FROM hits GROUP BY RegionID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, RegionID LIMIT 10), s AS (SELECT h.RegionID, h.OS, COUNT(*) AS c, AVG(h.ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_ttfb FROM hits h WHERE h.RegionID IN (SELECT RegionID FROM top_regions) GROUP BY h.RegionID, h.OS HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100), r AS (SELECT RegionID, OS, c, avg_ttfb, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RegionID ORDER BY avg_ttfb DESC, OS) AS rn FROM s) SELECT RegionID, OS, c, avg_ttfb, rn FROM r WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY RegionID, rn
translations.q018: SELECT t.UserID AS user_id, t.mobile_hits AS mobile_hits, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hits d WHERE d.UserID = t.UserID AND d.IsMobile = 0) AS desktop_hits, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.OS) FROM hits o WHERE o.UserID = t.UserID) AS os_count FROM (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS mobile_hits FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY UserID ORDER BY mobile_hits DESC, UserID LIMIT 20) t ORDER BY mobile_hits DESC, user_id
translations.q019: WITH f AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID), a AS (SELECT DISTINCT UserID, EventDate FROM hits) SELECT cohort_day, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS cohort_size, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_offset BETWEEN 7 AND 13 THEN UserID END) AS active_week2, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN day_offset >= 14 THEN UserID END) AS active_later FROM (SELECT f.UserID, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM f.first_day) AS INTEGER) AS cohort_day, CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM a.EventDate) AS INTEGER) - CAST(EXTRACT(DAY FROM f.first_day) AS INTEGER) AS day_offset FROM f JOIN a ON a.UserID = f.UserID WHERE f.first_day <= DATE '2013-07-07') x GROUP BY cohort_day ORDER BY cohort_day
translations.q020: WITH e AS (SELECT UserID, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) * 60 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime) AS mod_min, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) AS rn, LAG(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) * 60 + EXTRACT(MINUTE FROM EventTime)) OVER (PARTITION BY UserID ORDER BY EventTime, WatchID) AS prev_min FROM hits WHERE EventDate = '2013-07-20' AND IsMobile = 1), s AS (SELECT UserID, SUM(CASE WHEN rn = 1 OR mod_min - prev_min > 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sessions FROM e GROUP BY UserID) SELECT sessions, COUNT(*) AS users_n FROM s GROUP BY sessions ORDER BY sessions LIMIT 100
translations.q021: SELECT page_type, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT CounterID) AS counters, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(URL) LIKE '%.htm%' THEN 'html' WHEN LOWER(URL) LIKE '%.php%' THEN 'php' WHEN LOWER(URL) LIKE '%.asp%' THEN 'asp' WHEN LOWER(URL) LIKE '%.jpg%' OR LOWER(URL) LIKE '%.png%' OR LOWER(URL) LIKE '%.gif%' THEN 'image' WHEN URL LIKE '%/' THEN 'directory' ELSE 'other' END AS page_type, CounterID, ResponseStartTiming FROM hits WHERE URL <> '') AS p GROUP BY page_type ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, page_type
translations.q022: WITH ad_days AS (SELECT UserID, EventDate FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY UserID, EventDate) SELECT h.SearchEngineID, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users, AVG(h.ResponseEndTiming) AS avg_resp_end FROM hits h WHERE h.SearchEngineID <> 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ad_days a WHERE a.UserID = h.UserID AND a.EventDate = h.EventDate) GROUP BY h.SearchEngineID ORDER BY c DESC, h.SearchEngineID LIMIT 20
translations.q023: WITH top_r AS (SELECT RegionID FROM hits GROUP BY RegionID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, RegionID LIMIT 20), daily AS (SELECT RegionID, EventDate, CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS c FROM hits WHERE RegionID IN (SELECT RegionID FROM top_r) GROUP BY RegionID, EventDate), w AS (SELECT RegionID, EventDate, c, LEAD(c) OVER (PARTITION BY RegionID ORDER BY EventDate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS next_c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RegionID ORDER BY EventDate DESC) AS rn_desc FROM daily), dd AS (SELECT RegionID, EventDate, c, next_c, c - next_c AS drop_hits FROM w WHERE rn_desc > 1), r AS (SELECT RegionID, EventDate, c, next_c, drop_hits, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RegionID ORDER BY drop_hits DESC, EventDate) AS rn FROM dd) SELECT RegionID, EventDate AS drop_day, c AS day_hits, next_c AS next_day_hits, drop_hits FROM r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY drop_hits DESC, RegionID
translations.q024: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RemoteIP) FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1) AS mobile_ips, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT RemoteIP) FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 0) AS desktop_ips, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT RemoteIP FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY RemoteIP INTERSECT SELECT RemoteIP FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 0 GROUP BY RemoteIP) x) AS shared_ips ORDER BY mobile_ips, desktop_ips, shared_ips
translations.q025: WITH ad AS (SELECT UserID, EventDate, MIN(AdvEngineID) AS eng, MIN(EventTime) AS first_ad FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY UserID, EventDate), follow AS (SELECT a.eng, a.UserID, a.EventDate, MAX(CASE WHEN h.EventTime > a.first_ad AND h.IsNotBounce = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS engaged, MAX(CASE WHEN h.EventTime > a.first_ad AND h.IsLink = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS clicked FROM ad a JOIN hits h ON h.UserID = a.UserID AND h.EventDate = a.EventDate GROUP BY a.eng, a.UserID, a.EventDate) SELECT eng AS adv_engine, COUNT(*) AS user_days, SUM(engaged) AS engaged_days, SUM(clicked) AS clicked_days, CAST(SUM(engaged) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS engage_rate FROM follow GROUP BY eng ORDER BY user_days DESC, adv_engine
translations.q026: SELECT u.URL AS page_url, u.mobile_hits AS mobile_hits FROM (SELECT URL, COUNT(*) AS mobile_hits FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 AND URL <> '' GROUP BY URL HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20) u WHERE u.mobile_hits > (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hits d WHERE d.URL = u.URL AND d.IsMobile = 0) ORDER BY mobile_hits DESC, page_url LIMIT 30
translations.q027: WITH top_lang AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage FROM hits WHERE BrowserLanguage <> '' GROUP BY BrowserLanguage ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, BrowserLanguage LIMIT 8), pairs AS (SELECT BrowserLanguage, RefererRegionID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE BrowserLanguage IN (SELECT BrowserLanguage FROM top_lang) AND RefererRegionID <> 0 GROUP BY BrowserLanguage, RefererRegionID) SELECT BrowserLanguage, RefererRegionID, c, rn FROM (SELECT BrowserLanguage, RefererRegionID, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY BrowserLanguage ORDER BY c DESC, RefererRegionID) AS rn FROM pairs) t WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY BrowserLanguage, rn
translations.q028: SELECT lang_matches_country, IsMobile, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, COUNT(DISTINCT UPPER(BrowserCountry)) AS countries FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(BrowserLanguage) = LOWER(BrowserCountry) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS lang_matches_country, IsMobile, UserID, BrowserCountry FROM hits WHERE BrowserLanguage <> '' AND BrowserCountry <> '') t GROUP BY lang_matches_country, IsMobile ORDER BY lang_matches_country, IsMobile
translations.q029: WITH dr AS (SELECT EventDate, RegionID, SUM(CASE WHEN IsNotBounce = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS engaged FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY EventDate, RegionID), r AS (SELECT EventDate, RegionID, engaged, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY engaged DESC, RegionID) AS rn FROM dr) SELECT EventDate, RegionID, engaged, rn FROM r WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY EventDate, rn
translations.q030: SELECT side, COUNT(*) AS pairs, COUNT(DISTINCT os_code) AS os_values FROM (SELECT 'mobile_only' AS side, a.OS AS os_code, a.UserAgent AS ua_code FROM (SELECT OS, UserAgent FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY OS, UserAgent EXCEPT SELECT OS, UserAgent FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 0 GROUP BY OS, UserAgent) a UNION ALL SELECT 'desktop_only' AS side, b.OS AS os_code, b.UserAgent AS ua_code FROM (SELECT OS, UserAgent FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 0 GROUP BY OS, UserAgent EXCEPT SELECT OS, UserAgent FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY OS, UserAgent) b) s GROUP BY side ORDER BY side
translations.q031: SELECT m.SearchPhrase AS phrase, COUNT(*) AS mobile_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT m.UserID) AS mobile_users FROM hits m WHERE m.IsMobile = 1 AND m.SearchPhrase <> '' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits d WHERE d.SearchPhrase = m.SearchPhrase AND d.IsMobile = 0) GROUP BY m.SearchPhrase ORDER BY mobile_hits DESC, mobile_users DESC, phrase LIMIT 25
translations.q032: WITH p AS (SELECT URL, COUNT(*) AS views FROM hits WHERE URL <> '' GROUP BY URL), r AS (SELECT URL, views, SUM(views) OVER (ORDER BY views DESC, URL ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running, SUM(views) OVER () AS total FROM p) SELECT COUNT(*) AS pages_for_half, MAX(total) AS total_views, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM p) AS all_pages FROM r WHERE 2 * (running - views) < total
translations.q033: WITH reg AS (SELECT RegionID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY RegionID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50), adv AS (SELECT RegionID FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY RegionID) SELECT r.RegionID, r.c FROM reg r WHERE r.RegionID IN (SELECT RegionID FROM reg EXCEPT SELECT RegionID FROM adv) ORDER BY r.c DESC, r.RegionID LIMIT 20
translations.q034: SELECT kind, IsDownload, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(URL) LIKE '%.html%' THEN 'html' WHEN LOWER(URL) LIKE '%.php%' THEN 'php' WHEN LOWER(URL) LIKE '%.jpg%' OR LOWER(URL) LIKE '%.png%' THEN 'image' ELSE 'other' END AS kind, IsDownload, UserID FROM hits WHERE URL <> '') t GROUP BY kind, IsDownload ORDER BY kind, IsDownload
translations.q035: SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS dom, COUNT(*) AS active_counters, MAX(users) AS max_users, AVG(users) AS avg_users, SUM(CASE WHEN users >= 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS counters_100plus FROM (SELECT EventDate, CounterID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, CounterID) t GROUP BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) ORDER BY dom
translations.q036: WITH pc AS (SELECT SearchEngineID AS se, SearchPhrase AS phrase, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND SearchEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY SearchEngineID, SearchPhrase HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200) SELECT p.se, p.phrase, p.c FROM pc p WHERE p.c = (SELECT MAX(q.c) FROM pc q WHERE q.se = p.se) ORDER BY p.c DESC, p.se, p.phrase LIMIT 30
translations.q037: WITH h AS (SELECT EventDate, hr, COUNT(*) AS c FROM (SELECT EventDate, CAST(EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS INTEGER) AS hr FROM hits) x GROUP BY EventDate, hr), r AS (SELECT EventDate, hr, c, SUM(c) OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate) AS day_total, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY c DESC, hr) AS rn FROM h) SELECT EventDate, hr AS peak_hour, c AS peak_hits, day_total FROM r WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY EventDate
translations.q038: SELECT UserAgent, SUM(CASE WHEN EventDate > (SELECT MAX(EventDate) FROM hits) - 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS last_week_hits, COUNT(*) AS total_hits, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN EventDate > (SELECT MAX(EventDate) FROM hits) - 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*) AS last_week_share FROM hits GROUP BY UserAgent HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY last_week_share DESC, UserAgent LIMIT 20
translations.q039: SELECT proto, len_bucket, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(URL) LIKE 'https://%' THEN 'https' WHEN LOWER(URL) LIKE 'http://%' THEN 'http' ELSE 'other' END AS proto, CASE WHEN LENGTH(URL) >= 500 THEN 10 ELSE CAST(FLOOR(CAST(LENGTH(URL) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / 50) AS INTEGER) END AS len_bucket, UserID FROM hits WHERE URL <> '') t GROUP BY proto, len_bucket ORDER BY proto, len_bucket
translations.q040: SELECT m.EventDate AS event_day, COUNT(DISTINCT m.UserID) AS mobile_users, COUNT(*) AS mobile_hits FROM hits m WHERE m.IsMobile = 1 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits e WHERE e.UserID = m.UserID AND e.EventDate = m.EventDate AND e.SearchPhrase <> '') GROUP BY m.EventDate ORDER BY event_day
translations.q041: WITH top_net AS (SELECT IPNetworkID FROM hits GROUP BY IPNetworkID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, IPNetworkID LIMIT 50), hourly AS (SELECT IPNetworkID, DATE_TRUNC('hour', EventTime) AS hr, CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS c FROM hits WHERE IPNetworkID IN (SELECT IPNetworkID FROM top_net) GROUP BY IPNetworkID, DATE_TRUNC('hour', EventTime)) SELECT IPNetworkID, hr, c, prev_c, c - prev_c AS jump FROM (SELECT IPNetworkID, hr, c, LAG(c) OVER (PARTITION BY IPNetworkID ORDER BY hr ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND UNBOUNDED FOLLOWING) AS prev_c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY IPNetworkID ORDER BY hr) AS rn FROM hourly) t WHERE rn > 1 ORDER BY jump DESC, IPNetworkID, hr LIMIT 25
translations.q042: WITH uc AS (SELECT UserID, ParamCurrencyID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, ParamCurrencyID), un AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS ncur FROM uc GROUP BY UserID) SELECT uc.ParamCurrencyID, COUNT(*) AS users_n, SUM(CASE WHEN un.ncur > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_currency_users, SUM(uc.c) AS hits_n FROM uc JOIN un ON uc.UserID = un.UserID GROUP BY uc.ParamCurrencyID ORDER BY users_n DESC, uc.ParamCurrencyID LIMIT 20
translations.q043: WITH e AS (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE HasGCLID = 1 GROUP BY UserID EXCEPT SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE IsNotBounce = 1 GROUP BY UserID) SELECT h.Sex, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, SUM(h.HasGCLID) AS gclid_hits FROM hits h WHERE h.UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM e) GROUP BY h.Sex ORDER BY h.Sex
translations.q044: SELECT ref_scheme, url_scheme, COUNT(*) AS hits, COUNT(DISTINCT IPNetworkID) AS nets FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN Referer LIKE 'https://%' THEN 'https' WHEN Referer LIKE 'http://%' THEN 'http' WHEN Referer = '' THEN 'none' ELSE 'other' END AS ref_scheme, CASE WHEN URL LIKE 'https://%' THEN 'https' WHEN URL LIKE 'http://%' THEN 'http' ELSE 'other' END AS url_scheme, IPNetworkID FROM hits) t GROUP BY ref_scheme, url_scheme ORDER BY hits DESC, ref_scheme, url_scheme
translations.q045: SELECT h.Sex, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS searchers_who_act, COUNT(*) AS search_hits FROM hits h WHERE h.SearchPhrase <> '' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits d WHERE d.UserID = h.UserID AND (d.IsDownload = 1 OR d.IsLink = 1)) GROUP BY h.Sex ORDER BY h.Sex
translations.q046: SELECT hr, c AS slow_send_hits, roll6 FROM (SELECT hr, c, SUM(c) OVER (ORDER BY hr ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS roll6 FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE SendTiming > (SELECT AVG(SendTiming) FROM hits) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('hour', EventTime)) h) w ORDER BY roll6 DESC, hr LIMIT 20
translations.q047: WITH ua AS (SELECT UserAgent, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY UserAgent ORDER BY c DESC, UserAgent LIMIT 5), pc AS (SELECT h.UserAgent, h.PageCharset, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits h WHERE h.UserAgent IN (SELECT UserAgent FROM ua) GROUP BY h.UserAgent, h.PageCharset), ranked AS (SELECT UserAgent, PageCharset, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserAgent ORDER BY c DESC, PageCharset) AS rn FROM pc) SELECT UserAgent, PageCharset, c, rn FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY UserAgent, rn
translations.q048: SELECT dim, val, users_n FROM (SELECT 'flash' AS dim, CAST(FlashMajor AS INTEGER) AS val, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_n FROM hits GROUP BY FlashMajor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10000 UNION ALL SELECT 'silverlight' AS dim, CAST(SilverlightVersion3 AS INTEGER) AS val, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_n FROM hits GROUP BY SilverlightVersion3 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10000 UNION ALL SELECT 'referer_category' AS dim, CAST(RefererCategoryID AS INTEGER) AS val, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_n FROM hits GROUP BY RefererCategoryID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10000 UNION ALL SELECT 'currency' AS dim, CAST(ParamCurrencyID AS INTEGER) AS val, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_n FROM hits GROUP BY ParamCurrencyID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10000) t ORDER BY dim, users_n DESC, val LIMIT 100
translations.q049: WITH d AS (SELECT URLCategoryID AS cat, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS dy, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hits GROUP BY URLCategoryID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)) SELECT cat, dy, cnt FROM d WHERE cnt = (SELECT MAX(d2.cnt) FROM d d2 WHERE d2.cat = d.cat) ORDER BY cnt DESC, cat, dy LIMIT 50
translations.q050: WITH top_c AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 10), stats AS (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(ResponseEndTiming) AS sum_end FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM top_c) GROUP BY CounterID) SELECT s.CounterID, s.n AS hits_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(h.ResponseEndTiming AS BIGINT) * s.n > 2 * s.sum_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS slow_hits, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(h.ResponseEndTiming AS BIGINT) * s.n > 2 * s.sum_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / s.n AS slow_share FROM hits h JOIN stats s ON h.CounterID = s.CounterID GROUP BY s.CounterID, s.n, s.sum_end ORDER BY slow_hits DESC, s.CounterID
translations.q051: SELECT n_params, COUNT(*) AS hits, SUM(IsParameter) AS param_flagged, COUNT(DISTINCT IPNetworkID) AS nets FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN LENGTH(URL) - LENGTH(REPLACE(URL, '&', '')) + 1 >= 20 THEN 20 ELSE LENGTH(URL) - LENGTH(REPLACE(URL, '&', '')) + 1 END AS n_params, IsParameter, IPNetworkID FROM hits WHERE URL LIKE '%?%') t GROUP BY n_params ORDER BY n_params
translations.q052: SELECT hr, hits_cnt, avg_connect, SUM(hits_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY hr ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3h FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, ROUND(AVG(ConnectTiming), 2) AS avg_connect FROM hits WHERE EventDate = (SELECT EventDate FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, EventDate LIMIT 1) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('hour', EventTime)) t ORDER BY hr
translations.q053: SELECT h.CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users, SUM(h.DontCountHits) AS uncounted FROM hits h WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits m WHERE m.CounterID = h.CounterID AND m.IsMobile = 1) GROUP BY h.CounterID ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, h.CounterID LIMIT 20
translations.q054: SELECT bucket_id, COUNT(*) AS counters, SUM(hits_cnt) AS hits_total, MAX(hits_cnt) AS biggest FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN avg_rst = 0 THEN 0 WHEN avg_rst < 100 THEN 1 WHEN avg_rst < 300 THEN 2 WHEN avg_rst < 1000 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS bucket_id, hits_cnt FROM (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) AS c) AS b GROUP BY bucket_id ORDER BY bucket_id
translations.q055: WITH a AS (SELECT URL, COUNT(*) AS early FROM hits WHERE URL <> '' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-15' GROUP BY URL HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50), b AS (SELECT URL, COUNT(*) AS late FROM hits WHERE URL <> '' AND EventDate > '2013-07-15' GROUP BY URL HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50) SELECT a.URL, a.early, b.late, CAST(b.late AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / a.early AS growth FROM a JOIN b ON a.URL = b.URL ORDER BY growth DESC, a.URL LIMIT 20
translations.q056: WITH top_counter AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1), c AS (SELECT OS, URL, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 AND URL <> '' AND CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM top_counter) GROUP BY OS, URL), r AS (SELECT OS, URL, hits_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OS ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, URL) AS rn FROM c) SELECT OS AS os_code, rn, hits_cnt, URL AS page_url FROM r WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY os_code, rn LIMIT 60
translations.q057: SELECT share_bucket, COUNT(*) AS counters, SUM(hits_cnt) AS hits_total FROM (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, FLOOR(CAST(10 * SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / COUNT(*)) AS share_bucket FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) c GROUP BY share_bucket ORDER BY share_bucket
translations.q058: SELECT RegionID FROM (SELECT RegionID FROM (SELECT RegionID FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY RegionID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, RegionID LIMIT 50) m INTERSECT SELECT RegionID FROM (SELECT RegionID FROM hits WHERE ResponseStartTiming > (SELECT AVG(ResponseStartTiming) FROM hits) GROUP BY RegionID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, RegionID LIMIT 50) s) x ORDER BY RegionID
translations.q059: WITH top_regions AS (SELECT RegionID FROM hits GROUP BY RegionID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, RegionID LIMIT 50), rd AS (SELECT RegionID, EventDate, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE RegionID IN (SELECT RegionID FROM top_regions) GROUP BY RegionID, EventDate) SELECT a.RegionID, a.EventDate AS spike_day, a.c FROM rd a WHERE a.c > (SELECT AVG(b.c) FROM rd b WHERE b.RegionID = a.RegionID) ORDER BY a.c DESC, a.RegionID, a.EventDate LIMIT 20
translations.q060: SELECT ref_cat, rn, url_cat, hits_cnt, avg_rst FROM (SELECT RefererCategoryID AS ref_cat, URLCategoryID AS url_cat, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefererCategoryID ORDER BY AVG(ResponseStartTiming) DESC, URLCategoryID) AS rn FROM hits GROUP BY RefererCategoryID, URLCategoryID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) AS r WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY ref_cat, rn LIMIT 100
translations.q061: SELECT COUNT(*) AS urls_without_refresh, COALESCE(SUM(t.cnt), 0) AS their_hits FROM (SELECT URLHash, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hits WHERE URL <> '' AND IsRefresh = 0 GROUP BY URLHash ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, URLHash LIMIT 500) t WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM hits h WHERE h.URLHash = t.URLHash AND h.IsRefresh = 1)
translations.q062: WITH a AS (SELECT RegionID, COUNT(*) AS c, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS ttfb FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-16' GROUP BY RegionID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500), b AS (SELECT RegionID, COUNT(*) AS c, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS ttfb FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY RegionID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500) SELECT a.RegionID, a.c AS early_hits, b.c AS late_hits, a.ttfb AS early_ttfb, b.ttfb AS late_ttfb, b.ttfb - a.ttfb AS ttfb_delta FROM a INNER JOIN b ON a.RegionID = b.RegionID ORDER BY ttfb_delta DESC, a.RegionID LIMIT 20
translations.q063: SELECT EventDate, slow_connects, SUM(slow_connects) OVER (ORDER BY EventDate ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS slow_connects_3d, nets FROM (SELECT EventDate, SUM(CASE WHEN ConnectTiming > 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS slow_connects, COUNT(DISTINCT IPNetworkID) AS nets FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-01' AND EventDate <= '2013-07-31' GROUP BY EventDate) t ORDER BY EventDate
translations.q064: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hits_n, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_n, SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_hits FROM hits WHERE EventDate = (SELECT EventDate FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, EventDate LIMIT 1) GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) ORDER BY hr
translations.q065: SELECT SUBSTRING(URL FROM 8 FOR 4) AS host_prefix, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT CounterID) AS counters, AVG(FetchTiming) AS avg_fetch FROM hits WHERE URL LIKE 'http://%' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(URL FROM 8 FOR 4) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY c DESC, host_prefix LIMIT 15
translations.q066: WITH both_sides AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY CounterID INTERSECT SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE HasGCLID = 1 GROUP BY CounterID) SELECT h.CounterID AS counter_id, COUNT(*) AS total_hits, SUM(h.IsMobile) AS mobile_hits, SUM(h.HasGCLID) AS gclid_hits, AVG(h.ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst FROM hits AS h INNER JOIN both_sides AS b ON h.CounterID = b.CounterID GROUP BY h.CounterID ORDER BY total_hits DESC, counter_id LIMIT 15
translations.q067: SELECT first_day, new_users, SUM(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY first_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users FROM (SELECT first_day, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) f GROUP BY first_day) g ORDER BY first_day
translations.q068: WITH ad_counters AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY CounterID) SELECT h.TraficSourceID, COUNT(*) AS c, AVG(h.ConnectTiming) AS avg_connect, AVG(h.DNSTiming) AS avg_dns FROM hits h WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ad_counters a WHERE a.CounterID = h.CounterID) GROUP BY h.TraficSourceID ORDER BY c DESC, h.TraficSourceID
translations.q069: WITH ud AS (SELECT UserID, EventDate, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EventDate), u AS (SELECT UserID, SUM(c) AS total_c, MAX(c) AS peak_c, COUNT(*) AS active_days FROM ud GROUP BY UserID HAVING SUM(c) >= 50) SELECT active_days, COUNT(*) AS users_n, CAST(SUM(peak_c) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(total_c), 0) AS peak_share, SUM(CASE WHEN peak_c * 10 >= total_c * 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comet_users FROM u GROUP BY active_days ORDER BY active_days
translations.q070: SELECT flag_name, flagged_hits, flagged_users FROM (SELECT 'HasGCLID' AS flag_name, SUM(HasGCLID) AS flagged_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN HasGCLID = 1 THEN UserID END) AS flagged_users FROM hits UNION ALL SELECT 'IsDownload' AS flag_name, SUM(IsDownload) AS flagged_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN IsDownload = 1 THEN UserID END) AS flagged_users FROM hits UNION ALL SELECT 'IsEvent' AS flag_name, SUM(IsEvent) AS flagged_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN IsEvent = 1 THEN UserID END) AS flagged_users FROM hits UNION ALL SELECT 'DontCountHits' AS flag_name, SUM(DontCountHits) AS flagged_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DontCountHits = 1 THEN UserID END) AS flagged_users FROM hits UNION ALL SELECT 'IsMobile' AS flag_name, SUM(IsMobile) AS flagged_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN IsMobile = 1 THEN UserID END) AS flagged_users FROM hits) u ORDER BY flagged_hits DESC, flag_name
translations.q071: SELECT d, hr_start, c, rn FROM (SELECT EventDate AS d, DATE_TRUNC('hour', EventTime) AS hr_start, COUNT(*) AS c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, DATE_TRUNC('hour', EventTime)) AS rn FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY EventDate, DATE_TRUNC('hour', EventTime)) t WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY d, rn
translations.q072: WITH reg AS (SELECT RegionID, IsMobile, COUNT(*) AS c, AVG(FetchTiming) AS avg_fetch FROM hits GROUP BY RegionID, IsMobile) SELECT d.RegionID, d.c AS desktop_hits, d.avg_fetch AS desktop_fetch FROM reg d WHERE d.IsMobile = 0 AND d.c >= 100 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM reg m WHERE m.RegionID = d.RegionID AND m.IsMobile = 1 AND m.avg_fetch < d.avg_fetch) ORDER BY d.c DESC, d.RegionID LIMIT 20
translations.q073: WITH ud AS (SELECT UserID, EventDate, COUNT(*) AS pv FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 0 GROUP BY UserID, EventDate), b AS (SELECT CASE WHEN pv = 1 THEN 1 WHEN pv <= 5 THEN 2 WHEN pv <= 20 THEN 3 WHEN pv <= 100 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS user_days, SUM(pv) AS total_pv FROM ud GROUP BY CASE WHEN pv = 1 THEN 1 WHEN pv <= 5 THEN 2 WHEN pv <= 20 THEN 3 WHEN pv <= 100 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END) SELECT bucket, user_days, total_pv, CAST(total_pv AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / CAST(SUM(total_pv) OVER () AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS pv_share FROM b ORDER BY bucket
translations.q074: SELECT ResolutionHeight, COUNT(*) AS hits_n, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_n FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 0 AND ResolutionHeight IN (SELECT DISTINCT ResolutionHeight FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 0 EXCEPT SELECT DISTINCT ResolutionHeight FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1) GROUP BY ResolutionHeight ORDER BY hits_n DESC, ResolutionHeight LIMIT 25
translations.q075: SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS hopping_users, MAX(nets) AS max_nets FROM (SELECT UserID, EventDate, COUNT(DISTINCT IPNetworkID) AS nets FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EventDate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT IPNetworkID) >= 2) t GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY EventDate
translations.q076: WITH daily AS (SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate) AS dom, COUNT(*) AS hits_total, SUM(CASE WHEN SearchPhrase <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS search_hits FROM hits GROUP BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM EventDate)), shares AS (SELECT dom, hits_total, search_hits, CAST(search_hits AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(hits_total, 0) AS share FROM daily) SELECT a.dom, a.search_hits, b.search_hits AS search_hits_week_before, a.share - b.share AS share_change FROM shares a JOIN shares b ON a.dom = b.dom + 7 ORDER BY a.dom
translations.q077: WITH hh AS (SELECT EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)), r AS (SELECT EventDate, hr, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY c DESC, hr) AS rn FROM hh) SELECT EventDate, hr, c, rn FROM r WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY EventDate, rn
translations.q078: SELECT CASE WHEN URL LIKE 'https://%' THEN 1 WHEN URL LIKE 'http://%' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS scheme_id, CASE WHEN URL LIKE '%?%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_query, COUNT(*) AS hits_n, AVG(LENGTH(URL)) AS avg_len, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(URL) LIKE '%.html%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS html_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_n FROM hits WHERE URL <> '' GROUP BY CASE WHEN URL LIKE 'https://%' THEN 1 WHEN URL LIKE 'http://%' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, CASE WHEN URL LIKE '%?%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ORDER BY scheme_id, has_query
translations.q079: WITH inc AS (SELECT Income, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY Income) SELECT i.Income, i.c, i.avg_rst, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hits h WHERE h.Income = i.Income AND h.ResponseStartTiming > i.avg_rst) AS slower_than_avg FROM inc i ORDER BY i.Income
translations.q080: WITH f AS (SELECT UserID, MIN(EventDate) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) SELECT first_day, COUNT(*) AS new_users, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (ORDER BY first_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users FROM f GROUP BY first_day ORDER BY first_day
translations.q081: SELECT a.URLCategoryID, a.users AS early_users, b.users AS late_users, CAST(b.users AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(a.users, 0) AS growth FROM (SELECT URLCategoryID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-16' GROUP BY URLCategoryID) a JOIN (SELECT URLCategoryID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY URLCategoryID) b ON a.URLCategoryID = b.URLCategoryID ORDER BY a.users DESC, a.URLCategoryID LIMIT 30
translations.q082: SELECT Income, SearchPhrase, users, rn FROM (SELECT Income, SearchPhrase, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Income ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) DESC, SearchPhrase) AS rn FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY Income, SearchPhrase) t WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY Income, rn
translations.q083: SELECT CASE WHEN URL LIKE '%?%' THEN 'query' WHEN URL LIKE '%.html' OR URL LIKE '%.htm' THEN 'static' WHEN URL LIKE '%/' THEN 'directory' ELSE 'other' END AS url_kind, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT SearchPhrase) AS phrases, AVG(HistoryLength) AS avg_history, SUM(CASE WHEN JavaEnable = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS java_hits FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND URL <> '' GROUP BY url_kind ORDER BY c DESC, url_kind
translations.q084: WITH top_counter AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1), hourly AS (SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND(AVG(FetchTiming), 2) AS avg_fetch FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM top_counter) GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) SELECT hr, cnt, avg_fetch, COALESCE(MAX(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY hr ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS prev_hour_cnt FROM hourly ORDER BY hr
translations.q085: WITH g AS (SELECT URLCategoryID AS cat, Sex AS sx, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hits GROUP BY URLCategoryID, Sex) SELECT cat, sx, cnt, CAST(cnt AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(g2.cnt) FROM g g2 WHERE g2.cat = g.cat), 0) AS share_in_category FROM g ORDER BY cnt DESC, cat, sx LIMIT 40
translations.q086: SELECT a.SilverlightVersion3, a.users_n AS users_first_half, b.users_n AS users_second_half, CAST(b.users_n AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(a.users_n, 0) AS growth FROM (SELECT SilverlightVersion3, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_n FROM hits WHERE EventDate < '2013-07-16' GROUP BY SilverlightVersion3) a JOIN (SELECT SilverlightVersion3, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_n FROM hits WHERE EventDate >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY SilverlightVersion3) b ON a.SilverlightVersion3 = b.SilverlightVersion3 WHERE a.users_n >= 100 ORDER BY growth DESC, a.SilverlightVersion3 LIMIT 25
translations.q087: WITH hourly AS (SELECT EventDate AS d, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS mobile_hits FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)), ranked AS (SELECT d, hr, mobile_hits, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d ORDER BY mobile_hits DESC, hr) AS rn FROM hourly) SELECT d, hr, mobile_hits FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY d
translations.q088: SELECT UserAgentMajor, CASE WHEN UserAgentMinor = '' THEN 'empty' WHEN UserAgentMinor LIKE '%.%' THEN 'dotted' WHEN UserAgentMinor LIKE '% %' THEN 'spaced' ELSE 'token' END AS minor_shape, COUNT(*) AS hits_total, COUNT(DISTINCT UserAgentMinor) AS minor_variants FROM hits GROUP BY UserAgentMajor, minor_shape ORDER BY hits_total DESC, UserAgentMajor, minor_shape LIMIT 25
translations.q089: WITH busiest AS (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1), hourly AS (SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM busiest) GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM EventTime)) SELECT hr, hits_cnt, avg_rst, SUM(hits_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY hr) AS cumulative_hits, CAST(SUM(hits_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY hr) AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / NULLIF(SUM(hits_cnt) OVER (), 0) AS cumulative_share FROM hourly ORDER BY hr
translations.q090: SELECT ResolutionWidth FROM (SELECT ResolutionWidth FROM hits WHERE MobilePhone = 0 GROUP BY ResolutionWidth HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 EXCEPT SELECT ResolutionWidth FROM hits WHERE MobilePhone <> 0 GROUP BY ResolutionWidth) t ORDER BY ResolutionWidth LIMIT 50
translations.q091: SELECT CounterClass, ResolutionWidth, users, drk FROM (SELECT CounterClass, ResolutionWidth, users, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CounterClass ORDER BY users DESC) AS drk FROM (SELECT CounterClass, ResolutionWidth, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE ResolutionWidth > 0 GROUP BY CounterClass, ResolutionWidth) a) b WHERE drk <= 3 ORDER BY CounterClass, drk, ResolutionWidth LIMIT 100
translations.q092: SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(search_hits) AS hits_total FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT SearchPhrase) >= 20 THEN 20 ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT SearchPhrase) END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS search_hits FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY UserID) u GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
translations.q093: WITH js_on AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS on_hits FROM hits WHERE JavascriptEnable = 1 GROUP BY UserID), js_off AS (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS off_hits FROM hits WHERE JavascriptEnable = 0 GROUP BY UserID) SELECT profile, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(on_hits) AS on_hits, SUM(off_hits) AS off_hits FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN f.off_hits >= o.on_hits THEN 'mostly_off' ELSE 'mostly_on' END AS profile, o.on_hits AS on_hits, f.off_hits AS off_hits FROM js_on o INNER JOIN js_off f ON o.UserID = f.UserID) t GROUP BY profile ORDER BY profile
translations.q094: SELECT CASE WHEN UTMContent = '' THEN 'none' WHEN LENGTH(UTMContent) <= 10 THEN 'short' WHEN LENGTH(UTMContent) <= 30 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'long' END AS utm_content_size, COUNT(*) AS views, COUNT(DISTINCT UTMContent) AS variants, SUM(CASE WHEN UTMSource <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_source FROM hits GROUP BY CASE WHEN UTMContent = '' THEN 'none' WHEN LENGTH(UTMContent) <= 10 THEN 'short' WHEN LENGTH(UTMContent) <= 30 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'long' END ORDER BY views DESC, utm_content_size
translations.q095: SELECT RefererCategoryID, ResolutionHeight, users_n, rnk FROM (SELECT RefererCategoryID, ResolutionHeight, users_n, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefererCategoryID ORDER BY users_n DESC, ResolutionHeight) AS rnk FROM (SELECT RefererCategoryID, ResolutionHeight, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_n FROM hits WHERE ResolutionHeight > 0 GROUP BY RefererCategoryID, ResolutionHeight) a) b WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY RefererCategoryID, rnk LIMIT 100
translations.q096: WITH s AS (SELECT TraficSourceID, URL, COUNT(*) AS views FROM hits WHERE URL <> '' GROUP BY TraficSourceID, URL), st AS (SELECT TraficSourceID, SUM(views) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM s GROUP BY TraficSourceID) SELECT s.TraficSourceID, COUNT(*) AS standout_pages, MAX(s.views) AS top_views, MAX(st.n) AS pages_in_source FROM s JOIN st ON s.TraficSourceID = st.TraficSourceID WHERE s.views * st.n > 50 * st.total GROUP BY s.TraficSourceID ORDER BY s.TraficSourceID

translations.q039: SELECT proto, len_bucket, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN LOWER(URL) LIKE 'https://%' THEN 'https' WHEN LOWER(URL) LIKE 'http://%' THEN 'http' ELSE 'other' END AS proto, CASE WHEN strlen(URL) >= 500 THEN 10 ELSE CAST(FLOOR(CAST(strlen(URL) AS DOUBLE) / 50) AS INTEGER) END AS len_bucket, UserID FROM hits WHERE URL <> '') t GROUP BY proto, len_bucket ORDER BY proto, len_bucket
translations.q040: SELECT make_date(m.EventDate) AS event_day, COUNT(DISTINCT m.UserID) AS mobile_users, COUNT(*) AS mobile_hits FROM hits m JOIN (SELECT UserID, EventDate FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY UserID, EventDate) e ON e.UserID = m.UserID AND e.EventDate = m.EventDate WHERE m.IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY make_date(m.EventDate) ORDER BY event_day
translations.q041: SELECT IPNetworkID, hr, c, prev_c, c - prev_c AS jump FROM (SELECT IPNetworkID, hr, c, LAG(c) OVER (PARTITION BY IPNetworkID ORDER BY hr) AS prev_c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY IPNetworkID ORDER BY hr) AS rn FROM (SELECT IPNetworkID, DATE_TRUNC('hour', make_timestamp(EventTime * 1000000)) AS hr, CAST(COUNT(*) AS BIGINT) AS c FROM hits WHERE IPNetworkID IN (SELECT IPNetworkID FROM (SELECT IPNetworkID FROM hits GROUP BY IPNetworkID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, IPNetworkID LIMIT 50) top_net) GROUP BY IPNetworkID, DATE_TRUNC('hour', make_timestamp(EventTime * 1000000))) hourly) t WHERE rn > 1 ORDER BY jump DESC, IPNetworkID, hr LIMIT 25
translations.q042: SELECT uc.ParamCurrencyID, COUNT(*) AS users_n, SUM(CASE WHEN un.ncur > 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS multi_currency_users, SUM(uc.c) AS hits_n FROM (SELECT UserID, ParamCurrencyID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, ParamCurrencyID) uc JOIN (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS ncur FROM (SELECT UserID, ParamCurrencyID FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, ParamCurrencyID) x GROUP BY UserID) un ON uc.UserID = un.UserID GROUP BY uc.ParamCurrencyID ORDER BY users_n DESC, uc.ParamCurrencyID LIMIT 20
translations.q043: SELECT h.Sex, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, SUM(h.HasGCLID) AS gclid_hits FROM hits h WHERE h.UserID IN (SELECT UserID FROM (SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE HasGCLID = 1 GROUP BY UserID EXCEPT SELECT UserID FROM hits WHERE IsNotBounce = 1 GROUP BY UserID) e) GROUP BY h.Sex ORDER BY h.Sex
translations.q044: SELECT ref_scheme, url_scheme, COUNT(*) AS hits, COUNT(DISTINCT IPNetworkID) AS nets FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN Referer LIKE 'https://%' THEN 'https' WHEN Referer LIKE 'http://%' THEN 'http' WHEN Referer = '' THEN 'none' ELSE 'other' END AS ref_scheme, CASE WHEN URL LIKE 'https://%' THEN 'https' WHEN URL LIKE 'http://%' THEN 'http' ELSE 'other' END AS url_scheme, IPNetworkID FROM hits) t GROUP BY ref_scheme, url_scheme ORDER BY hits DESC, ref_scheme, url_scheme
translations.q045: SELECT h.Sex, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS searchers_who_act, COUNT(*) AS search_hits FROM hits h WHERE h.SearchPhrase <> '' AND h.UserID IN (SELECT d.UserID FROM hits d WHERE d.IsDownload = 1 OR d.IsLink = 1) GROUP BY h.Sex ORDER BY h.Sex
translations.q046: SELECT hr, c AS slow_send_hits, roll6 FROM (SELECT hr, c, SUM(c) OVER (ORDER BY hr ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS roll6 FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', make_timestamp(EventTime * 1000000)) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE SendTiming > (SELECT AVG(SendTiming) FROM hits) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('hour', make_timestamp(EventTime * 1000000))) h) w ORDER BY roll6 DESC, hr LIMIT 20
translations.q047: SELECT UserAgent, PageCharset, c, rn FROM (SELECT UserAgent, PageCharset, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY UserAgent ORDER BY c DESC, PageCharset) AS rn FROM (SELECT h.UserAgent, h.PageCharset, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits h WHERE h.UserAgent IN (SELECT UserAgent FROM (SELECT UserAgent, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY UserAgent ORDER BY c DESC, UserAgent LIMIT 5) ua) GROUP BY h.UserAgent, h.PageCharset) pc) ranked WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY UserAgent, rn
translations.q048: SELECT dim, val, users_n FROM (SELECT 'flash' AS dim, CAST(FlashMajor AS INTEGER) AS val, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_n FROM hits GROUP BY FlashMajor HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10000 UNION ALL SELECT 'silverlight' AS dim, CAST(SilverlightVersion3 AS INTEGER) AS val, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_n FROM hits GROUP BY SilverlightVersion3 HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10000 UNION ALL SELECT 'referer_category' AS dim, CAST(RefererCategoryID AS INTEGER) AS val, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_n FROM hits GROUP BY RefererCategoryID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10000 UNION ALL SELECT 'currency' AS dim, CAST(ParamCurrencyID AS INTEGER) AS val, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_n FROM hits GROUP BY ParamCurrencyID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 10000) t ORDER BY dim, users_n DESC, val LIMIT 100
translations.q049: SELECT d.cat, d.dy, d.cnt FROM (SELECT URLCategoryID AS cat, EXTRACT(DAY FROM make_date(EventDate)) AS dy, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hits GROUP BY URLCategoryID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM make_date(EventDate))) d JOIN (SELECT cat, MAX(cnt) AS mx FROM (SELECT URLCategoryID AS cat, EXTRACT(DAY FROM make_date(EventDate)) AS dy, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hits GROUP BY URLCategoryID, EXTRACT(DAY FROM make_date(EventDate))) d2 GROUP BY cat) m ON d.cat = m.cat WHERE d.cnt = m.mx ORDER BY d.cnt DESC, d.cat, d.dy LIMIT 50
translations.q050: SELECT s.CounterID, s.n AS hits_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(h.ResponseEndTiming AS BIGINT) * s.n > 2 * s.sum_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS slow_hits, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN CAST(h.ResponseEndTiming AS BIGINT) * s.n > 2 * s.sum_end THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / s.n AS slow_share FROM hits h JOIN (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(ResponseEndTiming) AS sum_end FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 10) top_c) GROUP BY CounterID) s ON h.CounterID = s.CounterID GROUP BY s.CounterID, s.n, s.sum_end ORDER BY slow_hits DESC, s.CounterID
translations.q051: SELECT n_params, COUNT(*) AS hits, SUM(IsParameter) AS param_flagged, COUNT(DISTINCT IPNetworkID) AS nets FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN LENGTH(URL) - LENGTH(REPLACE(URL, '&', '')) + 1 >= 20 THEN 20 ELSE LENGTH(URL) - LENGTH(REPLACE(URL, '&', '')) + 1 END AS n_params, IsParameter, IPNetworkID FROM hits WHERE URL LIKE '%?%') t GROUP BY n_params ORDER BY n_params
translations.q052: SELECT hr, hits_cnt, avg_connect, SUM(hits_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY hr ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3h FROM (SELECT DATE_TRUNC('hour', make_timestamp(EventTime * 1000000)) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, ROUND(AVG(ConnectTiming), 2) AS avg_connect FROM hits WHERE EventDate = (SELECT EventDate FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, EventDate LIMIT 1) GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('hour', make_timestamp(EventTime * 1000000))) t ORDER BY hr
translations.q053: SELECT h.CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users, SUM(h.DontCountHits) AS uncounted FROM hits h WHERE h.CounterID NOT IN (SELECT m.CounterID FROM hits m WHERE m.IsMobile = 1) GROUP BY h.CounterID ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, h.CounterID LIMIT 20
translations.q054: SELECT bucket_id, COUNT(*) AS counters, SUM(hits_cnt) AS hits_total, MAX(hits_cnt) AS biggest FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN avg_rst = 0 THEN 0 WHEN avg_rst < 100 THEN 1 WHEN avg_rst < 300 THEN 2 WHEN avg_rst < 1000 THEN 3 ELSE 4 END AS bucket_id, hits_cnt FROM (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000) AS c) AS b GROUP BY bucket_id ORDER BY bucket_id
translations.q055: SELECT a.URL, a.early, b.late, CAST(b.late AS DOUBLE) / a.early AS growth FROM (SELECT URL, COUNT(*) AS early FROM hits WHERE URL <> '' AND make_date(EventDate) <= '2013-07-15' GROUP BY URL HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50) a JOIN (SELECT URL, COUNT(*) AS late FROM hits WHERE URL <> '' AND make_date(EventDate) > '2013-07-15' GROUP BY URL HAVING COUNT(*) >= 50) b ON a.URL = b.URL ORDER BY growth DESC, a.URL LIMIT 20
translations.q056: SELECT OS AS os_code, rn, hits_cnt, URL AS page_url FROM (SELECT OS, URL, hits_cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OS ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, URL) AS rn FROM (SELECT OS, URL, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 AND URL <> '' AND CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1) top_counter) GROUP BY OS, URL) c) r WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY os_code, rn LIMIT 60
translations.q057: SELECT share_bucket, COUNT(*) AS counters, SUM(hits_cnt) AS hits_total FROM (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, FLOOR(CAST(10 * SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*)) AS share_bucket FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) c GROUP BY share_bucket ORDER BY share_bucket
translations.q058: SELECT RegionID FROM (SELECT RegionID FROM (SELECT RegionID FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY RegionID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, RegionID LIMIT 50) m INTERSECT SELECT RegionID FROM (SELECT RegionID FROM hits WHERE ResponseStartTiming > (SELECT AVG(ResponseStartTiming) FROM hits) GROUP BY RegionID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, RegionID LIMIT 50) s) x ORDER BY RegionID
translations.q059: SELECT a.RegionID, make_date(a.EventDate) AS spike_day, a.c FROM (SELECT RegionID, EventDate, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE RegionID IN (SELECT RegionID FROM (SELECT RegionID FROM hits GROUP BY RegionID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, RegionID LIMIT 50) tr) GROUP BY RegionID, EventDate) a JOIN (SELECT RegionID, AVG(c) AS avg_c FROM (SELECT RegionID, EventDate, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE RegionID IN (SELECT RegionID FROM (SELECT RegionID FROM hits GROUP BY RegionID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, RegionID LIMIT 50) tr2) GROUP BY RegionID, EventDate) b GROUP BY RegionID) m ON a.RegionID = m.RegionID WHERE a.c > m.avg_c ORDER BY a.c DESC, a.RegionID, a.EventDate LIMIT 20
translations.q060: SELECT ref_cat, rn, url_cat, hits_cnt, avg_rst FROM (SELECT RefererCategoryID AS ref_cat, URLCategoryID AS url_cat, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefererCategoryID ORDER BY AVG(ResponseStartTiming) DESC, URLCategoryID) AS rn FROM hits GROUP BY RefererCategoryID, URLCategoryID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) AS r WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY ref_cat, rn LIMIT 100
translations.q061: SELECT COUNT(*) AS urls_without_refresh, COALESCE(SUM(t.cnt), 0) AS their_hits FROM (SELECT URLHash, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hits WHERE URL <> '' AND IsRefresh = 0 GROUP BY URLHash ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, URLHash LIMIT 500) t LEFT JOIN (SELECT URLHash FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 1 GROUP BY URLHash) r ON r.URLHash = t.URLHash WHERE r.URLHash IS NULL
translations.q062: SELECT a.RegionID, a.c AS early_hits, b.c AS late_hits, a.ttfb AS early_ttfb, b.ttfb AS late_ttfb, b.ttfb - a.ttfb AS ttfb_delta FROM (SELECT RegionID, COUNT(*) AS c, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS ttfb FROM hits WHERE make_date(EventDate) < '2013-07-16' GROUP BY RegionID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500) a INNER JOIN (SELECT RegionID, COUNT(*) AS c, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS ttfb FROM hits WHERE make_date(EventDate) >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY RegionID HAVING COUNT(*) >= 500) b ON a.RegionID = b.RegionID ORDER BY ttfb_delta DESC, a.RegionID LIMIT 20
translations.q063: SELECT EventDate, slow_connects, SUM(slow_connects) OVER (ORDER BY EventDate ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS slow_connects_3d, nets FROM (SELECT make_date(EventDate) AS EventDate, SUM(CASE WHEN ConnectTiming > 100 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS slow_connects, COUNT(DISTINCT IPNetworkID) AS nets FROM hits WHERE make_date(EventDate) >= '2013-07-01' AND make_date(EventDate) <= '2013-07-31' GROUP BY make_date(EventDate)) t ORDER BY EventDate
translations.q064: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM make_timestamp(h.EventTime * 1000000)) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hits_n, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users_n, SUM(CASE WHEN h.IsMobile = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_hits FROM hits h INNER JOIN (SELECT EventDate AS top_day FROM hits GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, EventDate LIMIT 1) x ON h.EventDate = x.top_day GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM make_timestamp(h.EventTime * 1000000)) ORDER BY hr
translations.q065: SELECT SUBSTRING(URL, 8, 4) AS host_prefix, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT CounterID) AS counters, AVG(FetchTiming) AS avg_fetch FROM hits WHERE URL LIKE 'http://%' GROUP BY SUBSTRING(URL, 8, 4) HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1000 ORDER BY c DESC, host_prefix LIMIT 15
translations.q066: SELECT h.CounterID AS counter_id, COUNT(*) AS total_hits, SUM(h.IsMobile) AS mobile_hits, SUM(h.HasGCLID) AS gclid_hits, AVG(h.ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst FROM hits AS h INNER JOIN (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0 AND SUM(CASE WHEN HasGCLID = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0) AS b ON h.CounterID = b.CounterID GROUP BY h.CounterID ORDER BY total_hits DESC, counter_id LIMIT 15
translations.q067: SELECT first_day, new_users, SUM(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY first_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users FROM (SELECT first_day, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM (SELECT UserID, make_date(MIN(EventDate)) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) f GROUP BY first_day) g ORDER BY first_day
translations.q068: SELECT h.TraficSourceID, COUNT(*) AS c, AVG(h.ConnectTiming) AS avg_connect, AVG(h.DNSTiming) AS avg_dns FROM hits h INNER JOIN (SELECT CounterID FROM hits WHERE AdvEngineID <> 0 GROUP BY CounterID) a ON a.CounterID = h.CounterID GROUP BY h.TraficSourceID ORDER BY c DESC, h.TraficSourceID
translations.q069: SELECT active_days, COUNT(*) AS users_n, CAST(SUM(peak_c) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(total_c), 0) AS peak_share, SUM(CASE WHEN peak_c * 10 >= total_c * 9 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS comet_users FROM (SELECT UserID, SUM(c) AS total_c, MAX(c) AS peak_c, COUNT(*) AS active_days FROM (SELECT UserID, EventDate, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, EventDate) ud GROUP BY UserID HAVING SUM(c) >= 50) u GROUP BY active_days ORDER BY active_days
translations.q070: SELECT flag_name, flagged_hits, flagged_users FROM (SELECT 'HasGCLID' AS flag_name, SUM(HasGCLID) AS flagged_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN HasGCLID = 1 THEN UserID END) AS flagged_users FROM hits UNION ALL SELECT 'IsDownload' AS flag_name, SUM(IsDownload) AS flagged_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN IsDownload = 1 THEN UserID END) AS flagged_users FROM hits UNION ALL SELECT 'IsEvent' AS flag_name, SUM(IsEvent) AS flagged_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN IsEvent = 1 THEN UserID END) AS flagged_users FROM hits UNION ALL SELECT 'DontCountHits' AS flag_name, SUM(DontCountHits) AS flagged_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN DontCountHits = 1 THEN UserID END) AS flagged_users FROM hits UNION ALL SELECT 'IsMobile' AS flag_name, SUM(IsMobile) AS flagged_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN IsMobile = 1 THEN UserID END) AS flagged_users FROM hits) u ORDER BY flagged_hits DESC, flag_name
translations.q071: SELECT d, hr_start, c, rn FROM (SELECT d, hr_start, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d ORDER BY c DESC, hr_start) AS rn FROM (SELECT make_date(EventDate) AS d, DATE_TRUNC('hour', make_timestamp(EventTime * 1000000)) AS hr_start, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY make_date(EventDate), DATE_TRUNC('hour', make_timestamp(EventTime * 1000000))) g) t WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY d, rn
translations.q072: SELECT d.RegionID, d.c AS desktop_hits, d.avg_fetch AS desktop_fetch FROM (SELECT RegionID, COUNT(*) AS c, AVG(FetchTiming) AS avg_fetch FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 0 GROUP BY RegionID) d LEFT JOIN (SELECT RegionID, AVG(FetchTiming) AS avg_fetch FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY RegionID) m ON m.RegionID = d.RegionID WHERE d.c >= 100 AND (m.RegionID IS NULL OR NOT COALESCE(m.avg_fetch < d.avg_fetch, FALSE)) ORDER BY d.c DESC, d.RegionID LIMIT 20
translations.q073: SELECT bucket, user_days, total_pv, CAST(total_pv AS DOUBLE) / CAST(SUM(total_pv) OVER () AS DOUBLE) AS pv_share FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN pv = 1 THEN 1 WHEN pv <= 5 THEN 2 WHEN pv <= 20 THEN 3 WHEN pv <= 100 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS user_days, SUM(pv) AS total_pv FROM (SELECT UserID, EventDate, COUNT(*) AS pv FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 0 GROUP BY UserID, EventDate) ud GROUP BY CASE WHEN pv = 1 THEN 1 WHEN pv <= 5 THEN 2 WHEN pv <= 20 THEN 3 WHEN pv <= 100 THEN 4 ELSE 5 END) b ORDER BY bucket
translations.q074: SELECT h.ResolutionHeight, COUNT(*) AS hits_n, COUNT(DISTINCT h.UserID) AS users_n FROM hits h INNER JOIN (SELECT ResolutionHeight AS rh FROM hits GROUP BY ResolutionHeight HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 0) x ON h.ResolutionHeight = x.rh WHERE h.IsMobile = 0 GROUP BY h.ResolutionHeight ORDER BY hits_n DESC, h.ResolutionHeight LIMIT 25
translations.q075: SELECT EventDate, COUNT(*) AS hopping_users, MAX(nets) AS max_nets FROM (SELECT UserID, make_date(EventDate) AS EventDate, COUNT(DISTINCT IPNetworkID) AS nets FROM hits GROUP BY UserID, make_date(EventDate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT IPNetworkID) >= 2) t GROUP BY EventDate ORDER BY EventDate
translations.q076: SELECT a.dom, a.search_hits, b.search_hits AS search_hits_week_before, a.share - b.share AS share_change FROM (SELECT dom, hits_total, search_hits, CAST(search_hits AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(hits_total, 0) AS share FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM make_date(EventDate)) AS dom, COUNT(*) AS hits_total, SUM(CASE WHEN SearchPhrase <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS search_hits FROM hits GROUP BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM make_date(EventDate))) d1) a INNER JOIN (SELECT dom, hits_total, search_hits, CAST(search_hits AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(hits_total, 0) AS share FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM make_date(EventDate)) AS dom, COUNT(*) AS hits_total, SUM(CASE WHEN SearchPhrase <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS search_hits FROM hits GROUP BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM make_date(EventDate))) d2) b ON a.dom = b.dom + 7 ORDER BY a.dom
translations.q077: SELECT EventDate, hr, c, rn FROM (SELECT EventDate, hr, c, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY EventDate ORDER BY c DESC, hr) AS rn FROM (SELECT make_date(EventDate) AS EventDate, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM make_timestamp(EventTime * 1000000)) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY make_date(EventDate), EXTRACT(HOUR FROM make_timestamp(EventTime * 1000000))) hh) r WHERE rn <= 2 ORDER BY EventDate, rn
translations.q078: SELECT CASE WHEN URL LIKE 'https://%' THEN 1 WHEN URL LIKE 'http://%' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END AS scheme_id, CASE WHEN URL LIKE '%?%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_query, COUNT(*) AS hits_n, AVG(LENGTH(URL)) AS avg_len, SUM(CASE WHEN LOWER(URL) LIKE '%.html%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS html_hits, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_n FROM hits WHERE URL <> '' GROUP BY CASE WHEN URL LIKE 'https://%' THEN 1 WHEN URL LIKE 'http://%' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, CASE WHEN URL LIKE '%?%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ORDER BY scheme_id, has_query
translations.q079: SELECT i.Income, i.c, i.avg_rst, SUM(CASE WHEN h.ResponseStartTiming > i.avg_rst THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS slower_than_avg FROM (SELECT Income, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst, COUNT(*) AS c FROM hits GROUP BY Income) i INNER JOIN hits h ON h.Income = i.Income GROUP BY i.Income, i.c, i.avg_rst ORDER BY i.Income
translations.q080: SELECT first_day, new_users, SUM(new_users) OVER (ORDER BY first_day ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_users FROM (SELECT first_day, COUNT(*) AS new_users FROM (SELECT UserID, make_date(MIN(EventDate)) AS first_day FROM hits GROUP BY UserID) f GROUP BY first_day) g ORDER BY first_day
translations.q081: SELECT a.URLCategoryID, a.users AS early_users, b.users AS late_users, CAST(b.users AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(a.users, 0) AS growth FROM (SELECT URLCategoryID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE make_date(EventDate) < '2013-07-16' GROUP BY URLCategoryID) a JOIN (SELECT URLCategoryID, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE make_date(EventDate) >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY URLCategoryID) b ON a.URLCategoryID = b.URLCategoryID ORDER BY a.users DESC, a.URLCategoryID LIMIT 30
translations.q082: SELECT Income, SearchPhrase, users, rn FROM (SELECT Income, SearchPhrase, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY Income ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) DESC, SearchPhrase) AS rn FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY Income, SearchPhrase) t WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY Income, rn
translations.q083: SELECT CASE WHEN URL LIKE '%?%' THEN 'query' WHEN URL LIKE '%.html' OR URL LIKE '%.htm' THEN 'static' WHEN URL LIKE '%/' THEN 'directory' ELSE 'other' END AS url_kind, COUNT(*) AS c, COUNT(DISTINCT SearchPhrase) AS phrases, AVG(HistoryLength) AS avg_history, SUM(CASE WHEN JavaEnable = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS java_hits FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' AND URL <> '' GROUP BY url_kind ORDER BY c DESC, url_kind
translations.q084: SELECT hr, cnt, avg_fetch, COALESCE(MAX(cnt) OVER (ORDER BY hr ROWS BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING), 0) AS prev_hour_cnt FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM make_timestamp(EventTime * 1000000)) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS cnt, ROUND(AVG(FetchTiming), 2) AS avg_fetch FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1) tc) GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM make_timestamp(EventTime * 1000000))) hourly ORDER BY hr
translations.q085: SELECT cat, sx, cnt, CAST(cnt AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(cnt) OVER (PARTITION BY cat), 0) AS share_in_category FROM (SELECT URLCategoryID AS cat, Sex AS sx, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hits GROUP BY URLCategoryID, Sex) g ORDER BY cnt DESC, cat, sx LIMIT 40
translations.q086: SELECT a.SilverlightVersion3, a.users_n AS users_first_half, b.users_n AS users_second_half, CAST(b.users_n AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(a.users_n, 0) AS growth FROM (SELECT SilverlightVersion3, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_n FROM hits WHERE make_date(EventDate) < '2013-07-16' GROUP BY SilverlightVersion3) a JOIN (SELECT SilverlightVersion3, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_n FROM hits WHERE make_date(EventDate) >= '2013-07-16' GROUP BY SilverlightVersion3) b ON a.SilverlightVersion3 = b.SilverlightVersion3 WHERE a.users_n >= 100 ORDER BY growth DESC, a.SilverlightVersion3 LIMIT 25
translations.q087: SELECT d, hr, mobile_hits FROM (SELECT d, hr, mobile_hits, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d ORDER BY mobile_hits DESC, hr) AS rn FROM (SELECT make_date(EventDate) AS d, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM make_timestamp(EventTime * 1000000)) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS mobile_hits FROM hits WHERE IsMobile = 1 GROUP BY make_date(EventDate), EXTRACT(HOUR FROM make_timestamp(EventTime * 1000000))) hourly) ranked WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY d
translations.q088: SELECT UserAgentMajor, CASE WHEN UserAgentMinor = '' THEN 'empty' WHEN UserAgentMinor LIKE '%.%' THEN 'dotted' WHEN UserAgentMinor LIKE '% %' THEN 'spaced' ELSE 'token' END AS minor_shape, COUNT(*) AS hits_total, COUNT(DISTINCT UserAgentMinor) AS minor_variants FROM hits GROUP BY UserAgentMajor, minor_shape ORDER BY hits_total DESC, UserAgentMajor, minor_shape LIMIT 25
translations.q089: SELECT hr, hits_cnt, avg_rst, SUM(hits_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY hr) AS cumulative_hits, CAST(SUM(hits_cnt) OVER (ORDER BY hr) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(SUM(hits_cnt) OVER (), 0) AS cumulative_share FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM make_timestamp(EventTime * 1000000)) AS hr, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, AVG(ResponseStartTiming) AS avg_rst FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM (SELECT CounterID FROM hits GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, CounterID LIMIT 1) b) GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM make_timestamp(EventTime * 1000000))) hourly ORDER BY hr
translations.q090: SELECT ResolutionWidth FROM (SELECT ResolutionWidth FROM hits WHERE MobilePhone = 0 GROUP BY ResolutionWidth HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100 EXCEPT SELECT ResolutionWidth FROM hits WHERE MobilePhone <> 0 GROUP BY ResolutionWidth) t ORDER BY ResolutionWidth LIMIT 50
translations.q091: SELECT CounterClass, ResolutionWidth, users, drk FROM (SELECT CounterClass, ResolutionWidth, users, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY CounterClass ORDER BY users DESC) AS drk FROM (SELECT CounterClass, ResolutionWidth, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE ResolutionWidth > 0 GROUP BY CounterClass, ResolutionWidth) a) b WHERE drk <= 3 ORDER BY CounterClass, drk, ResolutionWidth LIMIT 100
translations.q092: SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(search_hits) AS hits_total FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT SearchPhrase) >= 20 THEN 20 ELSE COUNT(DISTINCT SearchPhrase) END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS search_hits FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY UserID) u GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket
translations.q093: SELECT profile, COUNT(*) AS users, SUM(on_hits) AS on_hits, SUM(off_hits) AS off_hits FROM (SELECT CASE WHEN f.off_hits >= o.on_hits THEN 'mostly_off' ELSE 'mostly_on' END AS profile, o.on_hits AS on_hits, f.off_hits AS off_hits FROM (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS on_hits FROM hits WHERE JavascriptEnable = 1 GROUP BY UserID) o INNER JOIN (SELECT UserID, COUNT(*) AS off_hits FROM hits WHERE JavascriptEnable = 0 GROUP BY UserID) f ON o.UserID = f.UserID) t GROUP BY profile ORDER BY profile
translations.q094: SELECT CASE WHEN UTMContent = '' THEN 'none' WHEN LENGTH(UTMContent) <= 10 THEN 'short' WHEN LENGTH(UTMContent) <= 30 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'long' END AS utm_content_size, COUNT(*) AS views, COUNT(DISTINCT UTMContent) AS variants, SUM(CASE WHEN UTMSource <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS with_source FROM hits GROUP BY CASE WHEN UTMContent = '' THEN 'none' WHEN LENGTH(UTMContent) <= 10 THEN 'short' WHEN LENGTH(UTMContent) <= 30 THEN 'medium' ELSE 'long' END ORDER BY views DESC, utm_content_size
translations.q095: SELECT RefererCategoryID, ResolutionHeight, users_n, rnk FROM (SELECT RefererCategoryID, ResolutionHeight, users_n, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY RefererCategoryID ORDER BY users_n DESC, ResolutionHeight) AS rnk FROM (SELECT RefererCategoryID, ResolutionHeight, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users_n FROM hits WHERE ResolutionHeight > 0 GROUP BY RefererCategoryID, ResolutionHeight) a) b WHERE rnk <= 3 ORDER BY RefererCategoryID, rnk LIMIT 100
translations.q096: SELECT s.TraficSourceID, COUNT(*) AS standout_pages, MAX(s.views) AS top_views, MAX(st.n) AS pages_in_source FROM (SELECT TraficSourceID, URL, COUNT(*) AS views FROM hits WHERE URL <> '' GROUP BY TraficSourceID, URL) s JOIN (SELECT TraficSourceID, SUM(views) AS total, COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT TraficSourceID, URL, COUNT(*) AS views FROM hits WHERE URL <> '' GROUP BY TraficSourceID, URL) s2 GROUP BY TraficSourceID) st ON s.TraficSourceID = st.TraficSourceID WHERE s.views * st.n > 50 * st.total GROUP BY s.TraficSourceID ORDER BY s.TraficSourceID
translations.q097: SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS c, SUM(CASE WHEN DontCountHits = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dont_count, SUM(CASE WHEN IsRefresh = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refreshes, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN SearchPhrase <> '' THEN SearchPhrase END) AS distinct_phrases FROM hits WHERE CounterID IN (SELECT CounterID FROM (SELECT CounterID, COUNT(*) AS sc FROM hits WHERE SearchPhrase <> '' GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY sc DESC, CounterID LIMIT 10) t) GROUP BY CounterID ORDER BY c DESC, CounterID
translations.q098: SELECT d1.dy, d1.cnt, d1.users, d1.cnt - COALESCE(d2.cnt, 0) AS delta_vs_prev_day FROM (SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM make_date(EventDate)) AS dy, COUNT(*) AS cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 0 GROUP BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM make_date(EventDate))) d1 LEFT JOIN (SELECT EXTRACT(DAY FROM make_date(EventDate)) AS dy, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM hits WHERE IsRefresh = 0 GROUP BY EXTRACT(DAY FROM make_date(EventDate))) d2 ON d2.dy = d1.dy - 1 ORDER BY d1.dy
translations.q099: SELECT ParamCurrencyID, RefererRegionID, hits_cnt, users, rn FROM (SELECT ParamCurrencyID, RefererRegionID, hits_cnt, users, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ParamCurrencyID ORDER BY hits_cnt DESC, RefererRegionID) AS rn FROM (SELECT ParamCurrencyID, RefererRegionID, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, COUNT(DISTINCT UserID) AS users FROM hits GROUP BY ParamCurrencyID, RefererRegionID) pc) r WHERE rn <= 3 ORDER BY ParamCurrencyID, rn LIMIT 60
translations.q100: SELECT EXTRACT(HOUR FROM make_timestamp(LocalEventTime * 1000000)) AS local_hour, COUNT(*) AS hits_cnt, SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mobile_hits, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) - (SELECT CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN IsMobile = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS DOUBLE) / COUNT(*) FROM hits) AS share_vs_overall FROM hits GROUP BY EXTRACT(HOUR FROM make_timestamp(LocalEventTime * 1000000)) ORDER BY local_hour
